description: This file implements the APIObjectVersioner class, which handles versioning and metadata extraction for Kubernetes objects, including updating resource versions, preparing objects for storage, and comparing resource versions.

classes.name: APIObjectVersioner
classes.description: A class that provides versioning and metadata extraction functionalities for Kubernetes API objects.

methods.name: UpdateObject
methods.description: Updates the resource version of a runtime object.

methods.name: UpdateList
methods.description: Updates the resource version, continue token, and remaining item count for a list object.

methods.name: PrepareObjectForStorage
methods.description: Clears resourceVersion and selfLink fields before storing the object.

methods.name: ObjectResourceVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the resource version as a uint64 from a runtime object.

methods.name: ParseResourceVersion
methods.description: Parses a string resource version into a uint64, with validation.

methods.name: CompareResourceVersion
methods.description: Compares two runtime objects based on their resource versions.
